options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: automaticconfigsync
options.description: GSLB configuration will be synced automatically to remote gslb sites if enabled.

options.name: dropldnsreq
options.description: Drop LDNS requests if round-trip time (RTT) information is not available.

options.name: gslbconfigsyncmonitor
options.description: If enabled, remote gslb site's rsync port will be monitored and site is considered for configuration sync only when the monitor is successful.

options.name: gslbsvcstatedelaytime
options.description: Amount of delay in updating the state of GSLB service to DOWN when MEP goes down. 			This parameter is applicable only if monitors are not bound to GSLB services

options.name: gslbsyncinterval
options.description: Time duartion (in seconds) for which the gslb sync process will wait before checking for config changes.

options.name: gslbsynclocfiles
options.description: If disabled, Location files will not be synced to the remote sites as part of manual sync and automatic sync.

options.name: gslbsyncmode
options.description: Mode in which configuration will be synced from master site to remote sites.

options.name: gslbsyncsaveconfigcommand
options.description: If enabled, 'save ns config' command will be treated as other GSLB commands and synced to GSLB nodes when auto gslb sync option is enabled.

options.name: ldnsentrytimeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, after which an inactive LDNS entry is removed.

options.name: ldnsmask
options.description: The IPv4 network mask with which to create LDNS entries.

options.name: ldnsprobeorder
options.description: Order in which monitors should be initiated to calculate RTT.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: mepkeepalivetimeout
options.description: Time duartion (in seconds) during which if no new packets received by Local gslb site from Remote gslb site then mark the MEP connection DOWN

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rtttolerance
options.description: Tolerance, in milliseconds, for newly learned round-trip time (RTT) values. If the difference between the old RTT value and the newly computed RTT value is less than or equal to the specified tolerance value, the LDNS entry in the network metric table is not updated with the new RTT value. Prevents the exchange of metrics when variations in RTT values are negligible.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: svcstatelearningtime
options.description: Time (in seconds) within which local or child site services remain in learning phase. GSLB site will enter the learning phase after reboot, HA failover, Cluster GSLB owner node changes or MEP being enabled on local node.  Backup parent (if configured) will selectively move the adopted children's GSLB services to learning phase when primary parent goes down. While a service is in learning period, remote site will not honour the state and stats got through MEP for that service. State can be learnt

options.name: undefaction
options.description: Action to perform when policy evaluation creates an UNDEF condition. Available settings function as follows: * NOLBACTION - Does not consider LB action in making LB decision. * RESET - Reset the request and notify the user, so that the user can resend the request. * DROP - Drop the request without sending a response to the user.

options.name: v6ldnsmasklen
options.description: Mask for creating LDNS entries for IPv6 source addresses. The mask is defined as the number of leading bits to consider, in the source IP address, when creating an LDNS entry.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
